body: A Colorado state court has placed Panorama Corporate Center in Centennial in receivership, BusinessDen reported on Nov. 18, 2026. According to the outlet, Arapahoe County District Court Judge Joseph Whitfield on Monday, Nov. 16, appointed Trigild IVL to oversee the six-building, 780,000-square-foot office complex, which BusinessDen described as having defaulted on its loan.

BusinessDen reported that the appointment was requested by Wells Fargo, the trustee of a $133 million loan issued in January 2016 to Denver-based Sagard Real Estate, which paid $190.6 million for the complex that month. The principal amount was reduced to $74.5 million later that year, according to Wells Fargo.
